review.shorterRoute: Reuse the native affine radial-arc parameter and integer boundary algebra unchanged. Adapt the existing geometric tree-walk and fundamental-loop construction through precisely its three elementary complex integral laws on skeleton paths: constant, reverse and concatenate. The actual cover regular-along-path integral theorems discharge those laws for every differential regular on the skeleton. This chooses each geometric loop before the differential and avoids repeating actual-field elaboration throughout the combinatorial proof. Coordinate integrals and generalizations to arbitrary additive targets are deferred.
review.assumptionsToDischarge: Existence of actual skeleton loops realizing the integer fundamental cycles, with local primitives and integral identities simultaneously for every actual differential regular on the skeleton. All path-law premises are discharged on the actual cover consumer, and the constructed dissection/tree/polygon/cycle witness is retained.
review.remaining: Coordinate-integral comparison, regular and meromorphic period generation, bilinear/third-kind reciprocity, unconditional cover Abel converse and auxiliary point division, arithmetic descent and remaining DUB-17--20 obligations remain open; 16/20.

discharged: The same actual marked analytic Euler dissection, tree/cotree, polygon and integer cycle system has actual loops in its skeleton, chosen before the differential. Every actual differential regular there has a primitive along each loop and an integral equal to the fundamental-cycle integer sum of actual positive edge-path integrals. The three elementary skeleton integral laws are all discharged from the proved cover regular-along-path laws; no integral-law or loop-existence premise remains on the actual constructed consumer.
